name: Cross-Chain Conservative
description: Conservative cross-chain policy pack for treasury operations that restricts assets, routes, and execution risk while escalating unusual paths.

rules.description: Restrict the pilot to explicitly approved chains.
Allow execution only when route health is within policy limits.
Always require explicit approval for cross-chain transfers.
Use lower caps for cross-chain treasury actions during early rollout.
Pause or escalate execution when settlement anomalies are detected.
